title: Week Summary: Sustainable AI, AI for Good, Frontiers, and Final Design Review

concepts.name: Sustainable AI
concepts.description: Designing and operating AI systems with attention to energy use, environmental impact, and long-term resource costs.

concepts.name: Energy consumption
concepts.description: The amount of energy required to train, serve, or operate a system.

concepts.name: Carbon footprint
concepts.description: The greenhouse gas emissions associated with computation, infrastructure, or operations.

concepts.name: AI for good
concepts.description: The use of AI methods to address socially beneficial goals such as health, education, safety, accessibility, or sustainability.

concepts.name: Final design review
concepts.description: A structured critique of a complete system design before implementation, presentation, or deployment.

concepts.name: System tradeoff
concepts.description: A choice that improves one system quality while potentially weakening another.

concepts.name: Operational risk
concepts.description: The possibility that a live system will fail, degrade, become unsafe, or be misused during operation.

concepts.name: Lifecycle maintenance
concepts.description: Ongoing work to update, monitor, debug, retrain, and govern a system after launch.
